script = """
import pdfplumber

pdf_path = "CUGA_generalist_agent/.cuga/skills/OfficeBench/testbed/docs/handbook.pdf"
output_path = "output/handbook_extracted.txt"

import os
os.makedirs("output", exist_ok=True)

all_text = []
with pdfplumber.open(pdf_path) as pdf:
    for i, page in enumerate(pdf.pages):
        text = page.extract_text()
        if text:
            all_text.append(f"--- Page {i+1} ---")
            all_text.append(text)

full_text = "\\n\\n".join(all_text)

with open(output_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(full_text)

print(f"Extracted {len(pdf.pages)} pages, {len(full_text)} characters total")
print("Saved to output/handbook_extracted.txt")
print()
print("Preview (first 2000 chars):")
print(full_text[:2000])
"""

print("Script written")
